title: Senior Software Developer, API Platform
descriptionHtml:
About Miovision:

At Miovision, we’re unlocking transportation networks that move you. Our vision and mission is to enable smart, fast, safe communities that simply flow, as we drive the Intelligent Mobility Revolution. Backed by the world’s most advanced traffic AI, Miovision’s innovations in traffic signal planning and operations are making it possible for cities to improve the transportation experience for drivers, cyclists and pedestrians.

Our values drive us. They’re at the core of everything we do. If they align with yours, proceed through the GREEN light!

  • All in to win: We're driven by a winning mindset, approaching every challenge with intensity, clarity, and speed.

  • One Miovision: We succeed as one team, uniting diverse talents, building on trust, and putting our shared mission before ego.

  • Be better every day: We're committed to continuous growth, staying curious, building mastery, and embracing challenges as learning opportunities.

  • Make it happen: We are proactive and results-driven, taking ownership, acting with urgency, and focusing on solutions that deliver real impact.

  • Earn the customer: We are deeply customer-centric, focused on earning our customers' partnership every day by delivering exceptional experiences that drive their success.

Position Summary:

Miovision is building the future of smart transportation, and our Platform Engineering team provides the core infrastructure that connects our entire product ecosystem. We are looking for a Senior Software Developer to lead the technical execution of our unified API gateway; the high-speed express lane that powers everything from our web applications to our AI-driven workflows. In this role, you will act as the traffic controller for our API ecosystem, ensuring data routes securely, seamlessly, and at scale across our architecture.

This role is instrumental in turning Miovision’s API surface into a true product: discoverable, versioned, secure, observable, and commercially ready for internal engineering teams, external customers, and integration partners. You will design and build the stateless, governed entry point for Miovision One (our web app), Mateo (our AI assistant), public APIs, CLI/SDKs, and AI agents, establishing the routing patterns and security standards that allow developers to build with confidence.

As a Senior Modern Software Engineer, you will sit at the intersection of Context, AI, and Core Engineering - combining deep domain understanding and business value alignment with AI-first workflows and high-rigor distributed systems engineering.

Objectives and Responsibilities:

  • Build the Gateway: Design, build, scale, and maintain our stateless API gateway, serving as the highly performant front door for all Miovision applications and services.

  • Architect for Scale: Keep architectural boundaries crisp by maintaining domain business logic in owning services, utilizing the platform API layer strictly for routing, access control, and formatting standards.

  • Commercialize the API: Embed usage tracking, billing hooks, tenant-aware access control, and rock-solid observability into the platform from day one.

  • Govern and Standardize: Partner with Architecture, Product, Security, and domain teams to enforce strict API governance, including versioning, backward compatibility, API linting, and contract testing.

  • Enable AI and Automation: Design machine-readable, agent-friendly API contracts that empower our AI chatbot (Mateo), MCP servers, and future AI agents to safely discover and invoke Miovision capabilities.

  • Drive Consensus: Champion cross-team alignment on complex domain modeling, resource naming, and API structures, transforming tough debates into clean, durable API contracts.

  • Publish and Document: Create crystal-clear service catalog entries and developer-friendly documentation so consumers can easily discover, understand, and adopt platform capabilities.

  • Code and Mentor: Roll up your sleeves to write high-quality code (primarily in Kotlin or Go), actively utilize AI-assisted development tools (like AMP), and mentor peers through deep technical design and code reviews.

  • AI-First Workflows: Embed and promote the use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., AMP, Claude Code, Copilot) within engineering workflows, while maintaining rigorous code quality.

The Ideal Profile:

  • Experience and Track Record: 7+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong focus on backend systems, platform engineering, or distributed architectures.

  • Core Systems Engineering and Technical Expertise: Strong backend development experience in Kotlin and/or Java (preferred), or Go, Python, or C, paired with hands-on experience in cloud-native ecosystems, AWS infrastructure, and containerization/orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).

  • API Gateway Architecture and Policy Patterns: Proven track record designing, building, or operating production API gateways or API platform layers using technologies such as Kong, Envoy, AWS API Gateway, Spring Cloud Gateway, NGINX, Apigee, or equivalent within a complex, multi-service environment—including gateway policy execution for routing, authentication, authorization, rate limiting, throttling, versioning, transformations, and observability.

  • Domain Modeling and API-First Design: Expertise in Domain-Driven Design (DDD), contract-first development, API specification frameworks, and OpenAPI specifications, with a proven ability to drive cross-team consensus on complex data structures.

  • Platform and Service Engineering: Demonstrated ability to transform fragmented internal services and APIs into a cohesive, commercially ready developer platform or service catalog.

  • AI-Assisted Development: Hands-on experience integrating AI coding tools (e.g., AMP, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) into daily development workflows to enhance productivity, generate tests, and refactor applications.

  • Modern Engineering Mindset: Experience operating within a modern DevOps/Platform Engineering culture, combining business context, AI acceleration tools, and engineering fundamentals while sharing accountability for reliability, observability, and security.

  • Architectural Judgment & Leadership: Strong architectural judgment, systems thinking, and communication skills, with an ability to write clear technical documentation, collaborate across multiple engineering pods, and balance immediate product delivery needs with long-term platform health.

  • AI Agent and LLM Ecosystems: Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or designing APIs optimized for AI agent consumption and LLM workflows.

Nice to Have

  • Edge Security and Identity Management: Experience implementing and enforcing authentication and identity management patterns at the edge using OIDC and Auth0.

  • Observability and Monitoring: Experience using Datadog.

  • Data & Eventing Stack: Familiarity with our broader data and eventing stack: Postgres, Snowflake, Kafka, and Redis.

This posting is for an actual vacancy.

Your Rewards & Well-being:
We invest in our team with benefits designed for modern life and true work-life balance.

  • Comprehensive Coverage: Your well-being is covered from day one with comprehensive health benefits, 24/7 virtual healthcare access, and dedicated wellness programs.

  • Financial Future: Build for tomorrow with our RRSP/401K Matching Plan and share in the company's success through our Variable Incentive Plan.

  • Time to Recharge: Truly unplug with our unique Mio-Days and flexible vacation policy.

  • Work & Life Support: We support you with flexible work options, an internet subsidy, a remote work allowance, and enhanced leave for new parents.

Sound like your next adventure? Apply now and let's start building together!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Please indicate if you require accommodation on your application, and our team will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

Miovision may use artificial intelligence (AI) to assist in the hiring process for tasks such as helping to identify qualified candidates, taking meeting notes, creating summaries, and streamlining administrative work. These tools are one of several factors considered in the hiring process and do not replace human judgement. We do not use AI to make any final hiring or interview decisions.

PLEASE BE AWARE OF FRAUD: Applicants interested in applying for roles at Miovision should apply directly via the details provided on our careers page. We communicate directly with applicants and will not request banking information, payment, or fees during any point of the recruitment process. We do not conduct interviews via text message. If you suspect that a third party is impersonating Miovision or requesting payment for recruitment on behalf of Miovision, please alert us via recruitment@miovision.com.

To all recruitment agencies: Miovision does not accept agency solicitation or resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our HR alias e-mail address, to any Miovision employee, or to other Miovision e-mail addresses. Miovision will not pay any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
